items.markdown:
To make classic Thai mango sticky rice, you will need `sticky (glutinous) rice, full-fat canned coconut milk, sugar, salt, cornstarch, fresh ripe mangoes, and toasted sesame seeds` . The rice is soaked and steamed, then sweetened with a warm coconut mixture.[](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/uy-MMyF2CpM) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/uy-MMyF2CpM)[[2]](https://www.modernhoney.com/mango-sticky-rice/)[[3]](https://www.thekitchn.com/mango-sticky-rice-recipe-23719063)

Key Ingredients

- **Sticky Rice:** 1 cup (200g) of Thai glutinous or sweet rice.
- **Sweet Coconut Milk:** 1 can (13.5–14 oz) of full-fat canned coconut milk.
- **Seasoning:** 1 2 one-half 1 2 to 3 4 three-fourths 3 4 cup granulated sugar and 1 2 one-half 1 2 to 1 teaspoon of salt.
- **Sauce:** 1 teaspoon cornstarch or rice flour (to thicken the salted coconut cream drizzle).
- **Fruit:** 2 large, ripe mangoes (preferably Ataulfo/Champagne).
- **Garnish:** 1 tablespoon toasted white sesame seeds.[](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/sticky-rice-mango) [[1]](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/sticky-rice-mango)[[2]](https://scientificallysweet.com/thai-mango-with-coconut-sticky-rice/)[[3]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/mango-sticky-rice/)
